2026-09-29 10:55:14.404735 | controller |
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404739 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404743 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404746 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404750 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404753 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404757 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-29 10:55:14.404760 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
